title: [Main][All-E] Warehouse Pick cannot be updated with newly received quantity after Purchase Receipt has been posted
summary: Inventory pick creation now allows additional quantities from newly posted purchase receipts to be added to existing picks by deducting already-outstanding quantities.
key_points: Removes restriction that skipped sales lines already having warehouse activity
Deducts quantities already outstanding on the pick to avoid duplication
Adjusts item-tracking quantities to prevent duplication while preserving existing lines
Users no longer need to delete and recreate picks after posting purchase receipts
quote: Allow additional lines on the same inventory pick, deduct quantities already outstanding on it, and adjust item-tracking quantities to prevent duplication.
